all.title: No posts yet
all.body: Write a post once and send it to your Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts.

drafts.title: No drafts
drafts.body: Posts you save without publishing wait here.

scheduled.title: Nothing scheduled
scheduled.body: Posts set to go out later show up here.

published.title: Nothing published yet
published.body: Posts you publish show up here, with a link to each one on its network.

failed.title: Nothing failed
failed.body: When a post doesn’t go out, it shows up here with what went wrong and how to fix it.

detail.title: Post
detail.notFound: This post doesn’t exist or was deleted.
detail.deleteBody: It’s deleted for everyone in the workspace. This can’t be undone.
detail.noTargets: No accounts chosen yet. Edit the post to pick where it goes.
detail.customised: {{network}} has its own version of this post.

target.cancelled: Not sent: the account was taken off this post.

errors.auth: {{network}} no longer accepts this account’s sign-in. Reconnect the account, then retry.
errors.content: {{network}} didn’t accept this post. Change what it didn’t accept, then retry.
errors.rate_limited: {{network}} asked us to slow down, and the automatic retries ran out. Retry in a few minutes.
errors.retryable: {{network}} couldn’t be reached, and the automatic retries ran out. Retrying usually works.

target.accountGone: This account was disconnected. Connect it again to retry.

retryErrors.POST_HAS_ERRORS: The post has problems to fix for this network first. Edit the post to see them.
retryErrors.TARGET_NOT_FAILED: This account is already being published to.
retryErrors.ACCOUNT_NOT_AVAILABLE: This account was disconnected. Connect it again to retry.
retryErrors.REVIEW_REQUIRED: This workspace reviews every post before it goes out.
